HediffDef.label: adult Goa'uld-family symbiote
HediffDef.description: An adult symbiote of Goa'uld origin resides inside this host. Depending on its persistent origin, the relationship may represent parasitic Goa'uld control or voluntary Tok'ra symbiosis. The symbiote grants major biological advantages while preserving its own identity. The host's original germline xenotype remains unchanged because adult implantation is acquired during life.
